# No-op state event handler

Stock handler that does nothing and reports the event handled.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x602a14bb` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Point unwanted events of an added state here instead of leaving them out of its table.
